mainEntity.name: Do government refusals create refund rights automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Outcomes are authority-controlled and do not create automatic refund rights.

mainEntity.name: Can a refund still be reviewed if work did not begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. That is one of the situations in which refund review may be appropriate.
